name: useSend Cloud Free
free_limit: Hosted free plan: up to 3,000 emails per month and 100 per day; 1 contact book, 1 sending domain, and 1 team member.
watch_out: Monthly and daily caps both apply. Paid plan has a $10 monthly minimum; verify upgrade behavior and any billing requirements before enabling paid usage. Free-plan credit-card requirement and commercial-use terms are not explicitly confirmed. Hosted email allowance is distinct from self-hosted AGPL-3.0 software, which requires separately funded infrastructure and email delivery.
